name: A forceful four-sword combat attack toward the right. Crouch
prompt: A forceful four-sword combat attack toward the right. Crouch deeply, turn the shoulders back and lift BOTH hand-held swords above the head. Step the right foot forward into a low lunge, rotate the torso and pull BOTH arms down and forward: both held blades carve large overhead-to-low diagonal slashes through the space in front, followed by a bent-knee follow-through. During this strike, BOTH hovering swords fly out from behind the shoulders to the RIGHT of the body, each rotating hilt-over-tip through its own large downward cutting arc in front of the fighter. All FOUR swords attack the same target space on the right, not the fighter. The two airborne swords must visibly leave the back, cut down in front, then travel back behind the shoulders. Recover the arms and feet into starting guard. Pronounced changes of knee, hip, shoulder, elbow and blade angles; complete windup, strike, follow-through, recovery. Fixed camera, no zoom, no idle bobbing.
